title: More control over cached responses
summary:
A small maintenance day: fresher cache control, a new Chat project, cleaner model names, and fewer old events hanging around.

A new DELETE endpoint lets builders explicitly invalidate cached data when their app needs a fresh result, rather than waiting for the cache to age out on its own.

PolliPalmTop has been added to Chat projects, while model aliases were reorganized and normalized so model naming stays more predictable across the API.

Buffered events now clear after a day, keeping transient system state from accumulating indefinitely. A Zod dependency dedupe also gets CI builds back onto solid ground, because builds enjoy inventing new forms of weather.

highlights.title: Nano Banana Pro
highlights.text: New `nanobanana-pro` model (powered by Gemini 3 Pro) featuring 4K resolution support and built-in reasoning capabilities.

highlights.title: Claude Opus 4.5
highlights.text: Access the powerful new Claude Opus 4.5 model via the text API using the model ID `claude-xlarge`. Check the [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs).

highlights.title: Advanced API Control
highlights.text: Added pass-through support for advanced parameters like `logprobs`, `logit_bias`, and `stream_options` for fine-grained generation control.

highlights.title: PolliPalmTop App
highlights.text: A new Android app featuring AI chat, web search, and image generation. [Try it](https://aiworld.institute/server/pollipalmtopv1.apk)
